card.name: 7 Completed
card.officialEffect: Activate this card by choosing ATK or DEF; equip only to a Machine monster. It gains 700 ATK or DEF, depending on the choice.

design.choice: ATK or DEF is a single activation-time choice; the adapter emits exactly one +700 modifier, never both.
design.target: Any face-up Machine monster on either shared TagDuel field is eligible; a non-Machine, face-down, missing or ambiguous target is rejected without retargeting.
design.ownership: The active physical member of the controller team must activate the source; the target may belong to either team.
design.stacking: Distinct Equip Spell UIDs produce independent +700 plans; the adapter does not aggregate or mutate stats.
design.integration: Pure adapter only; no metadata, resolver, equip persistence or Discord command integration until explicit M61 handoff.

tests: source face-up and not already equipped
duplicate event idempotency after target leaves field
distinct source copies create independent plans
state, LP, zones, stats and ledger immutability

certification.reason: Adapter-only; no metadata, effect definition, resolver, certification, manifest, allowlist or catalog changes.

limitations: The adapter does not admit 7 Completed into the playable catalog or persist Equip links/continuous modifiers.
Tests rely on already certified Machine targets (Jinzo and Cannon Soldier) and structural TagDuel fixtures.
No live Discord gateway validation or actual equipped-stat mutation is claimed.
No certification or inventory grant is claimed.
